# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m sonia.config_doc` from server/sonia/config.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Sonnia is configured only through environment variables. They are read from the process environment and from these files, the first one that defines a variable wins:

1. `overrides.env` in `SONIA_HOME` (per-machine changes that win over the rest);
2. `.env` at the repository root (copy it from `.env.example`);
3. `.env` in the current directory.

An empty variable is the same as an unset one: the default is used. `SONIA_HOME` is where the runtime data lives (`cache/`, `overrides.env`); it defaults to the repository root.

Never commit `.env`: it holds your API keys.

## Voice and conversation (GPT-Live)

Speech-to-speech engine (OpenAI GPT-Live).

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LIVE_URL` | text | `wss://api.openai.com/v1/live/sessions` | WebSocket endpoint of the speech-to-speech model. |
| `LIVE_API_KEY`<br>`OPENAI_API_KEY` | text | (empty) | API key. If `LIVE_API_KEY` is missing, `OPENAI_API_KEY` is used. |
| `LIVE_MODEL` | text | `gpt-live-1` | Speech-to-speech model. |
| `LIVE_VOICE` | text | `marin` | Built-in voice (marin, cedar, coral, shimmer...). Fixed for the whole session. |
| `LIVE_SAMPLE_RATE` | integer | `24000` | PCM rate in both directions. The API accepts 16000 or 24000. It is a validated `int` and not a `Literal`: from `.env` it arrives as text and pydantic does not convert text to an integer `Literal`. |
| `LIVE_BACKEND_MODEL` | text | `gpt-6-luna` | Responses API model that runs the delegated tasks and the actions. |
| `LIVE_BACKEND_REASONING_EFFORT` | text | `low` | Backend `reasoning.effort` (empty = the model's default). |
| `LIVE_BACKEND_SERVICE_TIER` | text | (empty) | Backend `service_tier` (empty = not sent; `priority` = faster). |
| `LIVE_BACKEND_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` | integer | `2000` | Token cap of each backend response, reasoning and searches included. With 400 web searches were cut short and the realtime model reported "Responses handoff incomplete"; only what it writes is billed, and its answers stay short. |
| `LIVE_BACKEND_MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS` | integer | `3` | Rounds of actions allowed to the backend per delegated task. |
| `LIVE_BACKEND_WEB_SEARCH` | true/false | `true` | The backend may search the web (the Responses API `web_search` tool, run by OpenAI) to answer what is not in the knowledge base. Each search is billed separately. |
| `LIVE_BACKEND_WEB_SEARCH_CONTEXT` | text | `low` | How much web context each search reads: `low` (faster), `medium` or `high`. |
| `LIVE_BACKEND_WEB_SEARCH_COUNTRY` | text | (empty) | Where Sonnia is, so searches give local results: ISO country code (`US`, `ES`...). Empty = not sent. |
| `LIVE_BACKEND_WEB_SEARCH_CITY` | text | (empty) | City for local search results. Empty = not sent. |
| `LIVE_SEGMENT_GAP_MS` | integer | `800` | Silence in Sonnia's voice that closes an utterance for the avatar client. |
| `LIVE_USER_TURN_GAP_MS` | integer | `1200` | Silence in the user's transcript that closes their turn. |
| `LIVE_GATE_RMS` | number | `0.0` | Noise gate: RMS level (0..1) below which silence is sent instead of the microphone. 0 turns it off. Keeps the realtime model from hearing background conversations; calibrate it on site. |
| `LIVE_GATE_HOLD_MS` | integer | `900` | How long the gate stays open after the last voice above the threshold. |
| `LIVE_COMFORT_NOISE_RMS` | number | `0.003` | Very soft noise (RMS 0..1) the realtime model hears when it is not sent the microphone (closed gate, muted microphone, recorded line, `--no-mic`). With absolute zeros it understood the user 7 to 40 s late and did not say what the backend returned until it heard something again. 0 = zeros. |
| `LIVE_VISION_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | number | `10.0` | Minimum time between two camera descriptions (each one is a vision model request). |
| `LIVE_CONTEXT_RESTART_RATIO` | number | `0.85` | Restart the session at the next quiet moment once the context passes this ratio. |
| `LIVE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` | number | `15.0` | Seconds to wait for the model WebSocket to open. |
| `LIVE_RECONNECT_MIN_SECONDS` | number | `1.0` | First wait before reconnecting; the waits grow up to the maximum. |
| `LIVE_RECONNECT_MAX_SECONDS` | number | `15.0` | Longest wait between reconnections. |

## Vision model

Vision model that describes the camera (the speech-to-speech model takes no images).

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LLM_BASE_URL` | text | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API. |
| `LLM_MODEL` | text | `gpt-6-luna` | Model with image input that describes camera snapshots. |
| `LLM_API_KEY` | text | (empty) | The key of the model server. |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY`<br>`LIVE_API_KEY` | text | (empty) | OpenAI key (`OPENAI_API_KEY` or, if missing, the realtime one, `LIVE_API_KEY`), only used when `base_url` is OpenAI's API. |
| `LLM_SUPPORTS_VISION` | true/false | `true` | If False, Sonnia does not look through the camera (no camera notes, no `look`). |
| `LLM_REASONING_EFFORT` | text | `none` | Sent as `reasoning_effort` unless it is `off`. An empty value cannot remove it: in `.env` it is the same as not setting the variable, which gives back `none`. `none` because with `low` the default model took twice as long to describe a photo. |
| `LLM_TEMPERATURE` | number | (unset) | Only sent when not None (some models only accept their default value). |
| `LLM_MAX_TOKENS` | integer | `400` | Token cap of each description. |
| `LLM_MAX_TOKENS_PARAM` | max_tokens \| max_completion_tokens | `max_completion_tokens` | Field name used to send `max_tokens`: OpenAI's API wants `max_completion_tokens` for its reasoning models; other servers, `max_tokens`. |
| `LLM_IMAGE_DETAIL` | text | `low` | `detail` sent with each image (low, high, auto). `off` does not send it: outside OpenAI the field is not documented and a strict server may reject it. |
| `LLM_EXTRA_BODY` | dict[str, Any] | (empty) | Extra request body fields, as JSON in `LLM_EXTRA_BODY`, for whatever each server needs (for example a flag that turns off a model's reasoning). |
| `LLM_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | number | `60.0` | Seconds before a vision request is given up. |

## Camera

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VISION_SOURCE` | opencv \| unity \| none | `opencv` | Opencv = capture from Python; unity = the avatar client sends frames over the WebSocket; none. |
| `VISION_CAMERA_INDEX` | integer | `0` | Index of the USB camera opened with OpenCV. |
| `VISION_CAPTURE_WIDTH` | integer | `1920` | Resolution requested from the USB camera if it opens below it (many webcams open at 640x480 on Windows even though they do 1080p). If it gives no image at that size, the camera keeps its own. 0 = whatever the camera gives. |
| `VISION_CAPTURE_HEIGHT` | integer | `1080` | Height requested from the USB camera (see `VISION_CAPTURE_WIDTH`). |
| `VISION_MAX_WIDTH` | integer | `768` | Snapshots are downscaled to this width before going to a model. |
| `VISION_JPEG_QUALITY` | integer | `80` | JPEG quality (1-100) of the snapshots sent to a model. |
| `VISION_ON_TURN_START` | true/false | `false` | Describe the camera when the user starts speaking (`[Camera]` note). Off by default: Sonnia only looks when she decides to, with the `look` action. |
| `VISION_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | number | `0.0` | Also attach a snapshot every N seconds even if the model did not ask (0 = never). |
| `VISION_DEBUG_SAVE_FRAMES` | true/false | `false` | Save snapshots to disk (debugging only; never with real visitors). |
| `VISION_DEBUG_DIR` | text | `<SONIA_HOME>/debug_frames` | Where debug snapshots are saved when `VISION_DEBUG_SAVE_FRAMES` is on. |

## Microphone

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AUDIO_INPUT_DEVICE` | text | (empty) | Index or name of the sounddevice input device ("" = default). |
| `AUDIO_BLOCK_MS` | integer | `32` | Size of the microphone blocks sent to the realtime model, in milliseconds. |

## Avatar client WebSocket

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `WS_HOST` | text | `127.0.0.1` | Address the avatar client connects to. Keep it local. |
| `WS_PORT` | integer | `8765` | Port of the avatar client WebSocket (the client takes `-sonia-ws` to match). |

## Idle animation

Idle animation: lines and sung dances when nobody is around.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SHOWCASE_ENABLED` | true/false | `true` | Say lines and dance while nobody is talking to her. |
| `SHOWCASE_FIRST_DELAY_SECONDS` | number | `25.0` | Seconds idle before the first bit. |
| `SHOWCASE_INTERVAL_MIN_SECONDS` | number | `40.0` | Minimum seconds between bits (each wait is random between both). |
| `SHOWCASE_INTERVAL_MAX_SECONDS` | number | `90.0` | Maximum seconds between bits. |
| `SHOWCASE_DANCE_CHANCE` | number | `0.3` | Probability that a bit is a sung dance instead of a line. |
| `SHOWCASE_GESTURE_CHANCE` | number | `0.5` | Probability that a line comes with a fourth-wall gesture. |
| `SHOWCASE_MOMENT_CHANCE` | number | `0.6` | Of what is not a dance, the share of moments: an invitation to come closer that the realtime model improvises from what is happening now (what the camera sees or something people can try) instead of a fixed line. 0 = fixed lines only. |
| `SHOWCASE_MOMENT_CAMERA` | true/false | `true` | Let moments also use what the camera sees (one snapshot described by the vision model every few moments; it is never stored). |

## Trivia

Trivia mode: multiple-choice questions on the avatar's screen.

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TRIVIA_ENABLED` | true/false | `true` | Offer the trivia game (the `start_trivia` action and its siblings). |
| `TRIVIA_QUESTIONS` | integer | `5` | Questions per game (drawn at random from `assets/trivia/questions.md`). |
| `TRIVIA_WIN_THRESHOLD` | integer | `3` | Correct answers needed to win. |
| `TRIVIA_REMIND_SECONDS` | number | `25.0` | With no answer for this long, Sonnia repeats the question once. |
| `TRIVIA_ABANDON_SECONDS` | number | `60.0` | Without hearing the user for this long, the game is cancelled (they left). |
| `TRIVIA_REVEAL_SECONDS` | number | `4.0` | After the last answer, minimum time the result stays on screen before the final screen. Between questions there is no timer: the next one comes when the user asks for it. |
| `TRIVIA_FINAL_WAIT_SECONDS` | number | `20.0` | Maximum wait for Sonnia to finish telling the final result before the final screen. |
| `TRIVIA_DEFAULT_LEVEL` | text | `medium` | Level when the user does not choose one: easy, medium or hard. |
| `TRIVIA_WIN_CONTACT` | text | (empty) | Who Sonnia sends winners to (for example "the people at the desk"); empty = nobody. Sonnia does not know about prizes: she never promises any. |

## Local control panel

Local web control panel (`sonia/panel`).

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PANEL_ENABLED` | true/false | `true` | Serve the local control panel while `sonia run` is running. |
| `PANEL_HOST` | text | `127.0.0.1` | Local only: the panel has no authentication of its own. |
| `PANEL_PORT` | integer | `8780` | Port of the local control panel. |
| `PANEL_STATE_FILE` | text | `<SONIA_HOME>/cache/panel_state.json` | Where the panel state is saved (mode, notes, volume...). |
| `PANEL_VOICE_CACHE_DIR` | text | `<SONIA_HOME>/cache/voice` | Cache of fixed lines recorded with the realtime model's voice. |
| `PANEL_GREETER_INTERVAL_MIN_SECONDS` | number | `25.0` | "Greeter" mode: minimum seconds between recorded greetings. |
| `PANEL_GREETER_INTERVAL_MAX_SECONDS` | number | `55.0` | "Greeter" mode: maximum seconds between recorded greetings. |
| `PANEL_LIVE_PRICE_PER_MINUTE` | number | `0.05` | Realtime model price per session minute, to estimate the cost. |

## General

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ASSETS_DIR` | text | `<repo>/assets` | Knowledge, idle lines, trivia bank and gallery. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | text | `INFO` | DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR. |
| `DEVICES_FILE` | text | `<SONIA_HOME>/cache/devices.json` | Microphone and camera chosen in the avatar's options menu (sonia/devices.py). |
| `TIMEZONE` | text | (empty) | The IANA time zone Sonnia uses for the date and time she knows (for example `Europe/Madrid`). Empty = the system time zone. |
| `IDLE_RESET_SECONDS` | number | `120.0` | Restart the conversation after N seconds without activity (kiosk mode). |
| `IMAGE_AUTO_HIDE_SECONDS` | number | `30.0` | Hide a shown image on its own after N seconds (0 = never). The model hides it when the topic changes, but if it forgets, the image does not stay there. |
| `GALLERY_WATCH_SECONDS` | number | `5.0` | How often `assets/gallery` is checked; what is added or removed is told to the open session with a silent `[Gallery]` note (0 = do not watch: the new list arrives with the next session). |
| `GALLERY_UPLOAD_DIR` | text | `<SONIA_HOME>/cache/gallery` | Where images uploaded from the panel are stored. Writable and outside `assets`, which may live inside a read-only app bundle. |
| `KNOWLEDGE_EXTRA_DIR` | text | (empty) | Another knowledge folder read after `assets/knowledge`, for example with test data. Empty by default. |
| `SONIA_PARENT_PID` | integer | (unset) | The PID of the app that launched the orchestrator (the avatar client sets it when it starts the orchestrator itself). If that app dies, the orchestrator exits on its own (`sonia/parent.py`). Empty when launched by hand. |
